tickets.title: Contact Professional About Trust Account Administration
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Coordinate trust account administration for Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk / [Trust Name].

Suggested message outline:
Hello Galen Copperwisp,
We are assisting Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk with administration items for [Trust Name]. With appropriate authorization, we would like to confirm the next steps for documentation update.

Items to confirm:
- Your role and preferred contact method: Paper Otter Law attorney
- Current trust documentation needed: Trust, will, durable power of attorney, and health care directive package (signed 2012)
- Authorized trustee or fiduciary names: Edmund Nettlewhisk (first successor, deceased), Callie Nettlewhisk (alternate, relocated outside US)
- Tax identification or certification requirements: [Requirements]
- Custodian paperwork or medallion/signature requirements: [Paperwork]
- Distribution, contribution, or investment restrictions: [Restrictions]
- Expected review sequence and any professional approvals needed: [Process]

Please let us know what documentation is required and whether there are any constraints we should reflect before proceeding.

The review should compare the 2012 documents against the household's current assets (joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody valued at $1.86M as of 2024-05-20, Leah's Moonbadger Robotics 401(k) at $1.24M, Marcus's SEP IRA at $620K, primary residence near $1.4M), dependents Iris (19) and Theo (16), and legacy preferences.

tickets.title: Review Benefits Enrollment Choices
tickets.text:
Review Leah Nettlewhisk's open enrollment packet for benefit elections, HSA/FSA options, life and disability coverage, beneficiary designations, and retirement plan contribution changes before the enrollment window closes.

Focus on checking the life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens in the Moonbadger Robotics benefits portal before Leah finalizes her employer benefit elections.
tickets.evidence: For the employer benefit beneficiary review, Leah’s Moonbadger Robotics benefits portal is in its current election window, and the life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens need to be checked before she finalizes employer benefit elections; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-03.

tickets.title: Collect missing estate and beneficiary records
tickets.text: Obtain signed copies of the Nettlewhisks' health care directives from Paper Otter Law, Marcus's SEP IRA beneficiary confirmation from Velvet Acorn Custody, and Leah's full employer life insurance beneficiary page from Moonbadger Robotics to complete the estate binder.

tickets.text: Reconcile the different beneficiary structures across Leah's IRA, employer life insurance, Marcus's SEP IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, and the estate plan, including contingent beneficiaries that do not match the couple's current trustee and guardianship preferences.

tickets.title: Resolve Velvet Acorn Custody portal estate record issue
tickets.text: Resolve the obsolete trust certification displayed in the Velvet Acorn Custody portal and ensure the prior upload of updated contact information appears in the shared document vault for the Nettlewhisk household.
tickets.evidence: For the custodian portal estate record issue, Leah reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody portal still displays an obsolete trust certification and that a prior upload of updated contact information did not appear in the shared document vault; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-05-30.

tickets.title: Summarize account titling differences for attorney review
tickets.text: Summarize the titling differences between the joint taxable account, cash reserve accounts, and one older individual account versus the revocable trust structure for the Nettlewhisk estate, for review by Paper Otter Law.
tickets.evidence: Priya’s review found that the joint taxable account, cash reserve accounts, and one older individual account are titled differently from the revocable trust structure described in the estate documents, so the titling needs to be summarized for attorney review; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-18.
